title: Wortlaut
description: Runs one command of Wortlaut. A repository usually sets the options once in targetDefaults and picks the mode through a configuration.

envFile.description: A .env file relative to the project, for the values that options read as {env.NAME}.

cache.description: Reuses the results of files that did not change, for analyze and detect.

actions.description: The options of each command: detect, analyze, transform, sort and generate.

expectedLocales.description: Each of these locales must have at least one translation key in the catalog roots.
